answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into durable stone, agents validate identity through recursive trust crystallization. A newcomer begins as a marble, cold and unverified; every genuine peer interaction acts as a lantern casting light upon valid computational work. When a rogue entity seeks to flood the consensus with forged identities, a quiet whisper travels across the mesh to impose superlinear staking collateral on new branches, forcing attacker cost to scale exponentially with each Sybil node created.
